body:
Implemented the founder's Itch-launch auth-funnel spec: (1) bumped grandfatherDailyCap 20->25 across the single source of truth + full test suite, live-verified fresh guests now get 25; (2) audited guest-upgrade (the Claim Account backend) against all 4 spec points (email uniqueness, guest-only via player_credentials check, bcrypt hash, player_id preservation) -- already fully correct from an earlier session, live-verified end to end including a 409 on double-claim; (3) consolidated the Back Office nav per founder ask ('clean up the menu so it just says DEADWEIGHT and the sub pages have 2 tabs') -- new /admin/deadweight hub with Claim Codes and a new Players tab (real account_state/founder/tickets per player, useful for confirming claims are landing without a DB shell). Full handlers suite green, real smoke test run and discarded before deploy, live-verified against production. Commits b69bd65, c2264a7.

⚓ ☃
title: 25-ticket cap + Claim Account audit + admin nav consolidation (S522/S523)
